name: rival
description: Rival monorepo root — a thin launcher for LOCAL DEVELOPMENT only.

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.setup: npm run install:all && npm --prefix backend run prisma:generate
scripts.dev: sh -c 'trap "kill 0" INT TERM; npm --prefix backend run dev & npm --prefix frontend run dev & wait'
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix backend run typecheck && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck
